record.dic_text:
01185 Ba`alic {ba-a-li:s'}

可能源自 05965 並加上介系詞字首; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Baalis 1; 1

巴利斯 = "旗號之主: 帶來喜樂"
1) 亞捫王, 於耶路撒冷被尼布甲尼撒王毀滅的時代作王 (#耶 40:14|)
record.edic_text:
01185 Ba`alic {bah-al-ece'}

probably from a derivative of 05965 with prepositional prefix;; n pr m

AV - Baalis 1; 1

Baalis = "lord of the banner: in causing the joy"
1) king of the Ammonites at the time of the destruction of Jerusalem
   by Nebuchadnezzar
